service.en: Create a company account with the Department of Municipalities and Transport
service.ar: إنشاء حساب شركة لدى دائرة البلديات والنقل
service.ur: محکمہ بلدیات و ٹرانسپورٹ میں کمپنی اکاؤنٹ بنانا
service.ml: മുനിസിപ്പാലിറ്റീസ് ആൻഡ് ട്രാൻസ്പോർട്ട് വകുപ്പിൽ കമ്പനി അക്കൗണ്ട് തുറക്കൽ

about: Open a company account to use the Department of Municipalities and Transport services.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Trade licence (unless issued by the Department of Economic Development)
Memorandum of association or power of attorney
timing: You get approval to open the account
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
